claims.claim_text: 文章稱推論時的 FLOPs 比 2024 年版本少約 300 倍，單張 GH200 上超過每秒 100 億則廣告
claims.evidence: at approximately 300x fewer inference-time FLOPs than the 2024 Meta Andromeda retrieval model; The fused kernel now runs at over 10 billion ads per second on a single GH200.
claims.note: Source ties 300x to the retrieval MoE gating architecture; lede is attributed to the article.

claims.claim_text: 文章稱共置後的單一 GPU 管線，每個 GPU 伺服器每秒可處理超過 10 億則廣告
claims.evidence: the fully co-located single GPU pipeline processes over one billion ads per second on a single GPU server
claims.note: Source figure is per single GPU server, not whole-system. Correct to e.g. 單一 GPU 伺服器每秒可處理超過 10 億則廣告.

claims.claim_text: 自 2025 年起讓 Facebook 的轉換增加 2.4%
claims.evidence: Since 2025, Meta Andromeda has delivered a 2.4% increase in conversions on Facebook.
claims.note: Attributed in lede to Meta's own numbers.

claims.claim_text: 平均 9.8 分，作者原本的 harness 為 9.6，Fable 5 單次呼叫為 8.0
claims.evidence: On a sample this small, 9.8 and 9.6 are the same number.
claims.note: Results table: 9.8 (this workflow), 9.6 (authors' harness), 8.0 (Fable 5, one call, not run in this harness). First ten LiveCodeBench Hard problems, five passes each; contests date from spring 2025; contamination cannot be ruled out; model Qwen3.8-27B; eight YAML files, no code; GVS5H method.

claims.claim_text: 2026 上半年在 diff 階段攔下 74 個嚴重隱私 bug，隱私 SEV 整體減少 20%
claims.evidence: 74 serious (SEV) privacy bugs at the diff stage, before they landed in production
claims.note: Source: lowered the overall occurrence of privacy SEVs by 20% during that timeframe (H1 2026). Lede attributes to Meta internal numbers.

claims.claim_text: 文章稱已有 589 位工程師（占通知對象的 64%）回應，真陽性率 60%
claims.evidence: 589 engineers at Meta (64% of our outreach) have engaged with Catching JiTTests
claims.note: Source says 'engaged' and 'outreach' rather than 'responded'/'notified'; close paraphrase. 60% true-positive rate is reported by engineers.

claims.claim_text: 核心 CNA 評為 CVSS 3.1 的 9.8，漏洞最早可追溯到 Linux 4.4，上游修補只有四行
claims.evidence: a use-after-free in the IPv4 TCP handshake that a remote, unauthenticated peer can reach
claims.note: Page says kernel CNA scores 9.8 Critical, bug goes back to 4.4, and calls it a four-line change (diff summary on page garbled, +2 -22). Weak-ish on line count but source states it.

claims.claim_text: 穩定版核心在 10 月 11 日與 15 日已發布修補，但 Atlas 在 10 月 31 日下午 5:15（CDT）仍記錄 Ubuntu 各版本與 RHEL 8、9、10 沒有修好的核心
claims.evidence: Ubuntu tracker 'Vulnerable' for every release; Red Hat lists RHEL 8, 9, 10 as affected with no fix; 7.2.10 and 6.18.56 shipped October 11, others October 15
claims.note: Ubuntu 26.10/26.04/24.04/22.04 also show work-in-progress versions; lede attributes to Atlas.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic 稱 Claude 寫出了在有 multipath TCP listener 的 Linux 伺服器上以 root 執行指令的 PoC，Go Security Team 則說 Go 程式預設會開 multipath TCP listener
claims.evidence: as of Go 1.24, Go programs enable MPTCP by default for listen sockets on Linux
claims.note: Anthropic's claim quoted on page; exploit unpublished. Go default depends on go.mod go line and kernel MPTCP support (lede omits; minor).

claims.claim_text: 把 proxied 的 A 或 AAAA 記錄指向私有 IP，……origin 不必開入站防火牆例外。RFC 1918、RFC 6598 與 RFC 4193 範圍的位址會自動啟用私有路由，且無法關閉
claims.evidence: Point a proxied A or AAAA record at a private IP ... with no inbound firewall exception required ... It can't be turned off for these ranges
claims.note: 'Generally available' confirmed. WAF/cache/bot/Workers 'work just as they do for public origins'; lede lists Argo and Dedicated CDN Egress IPs exceptions, confirmed, and missing return route as most common beta failure, confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 2026 年第三季自動緩解了 1,820 萬次網路層 DDoS 攻擊，約每 0.44 秒一次，較 2025 年同季增加 208%；報告說其中 96% 在 10 分鐘內結束、98% 低於 1 Gbps
claims.evidence: autonomously mitigated 18.2 million network-layer DDoS attacks ... one attack every 0.44 seconds ... a +208% increase from the same quarter in 2025
claims.note: 96% 'ended in under 10 minutes', 98% 'stayed under 1 Gbps'. Source's Key Insights separately attribute a 208% surge to short-burst low-bandwidth attacks; headline total YoY is also +208%.

claims.claim_text: 超過 1 Tbps 的攻擊從第二季的 805 次降到 251 次，報告把這件事與執法行動拆除四個大型 IoT 殭屍網路並列，措辭是「coinciding」，並未直接斷言因果
claims.evidence: dropping to 251 attacks in Q3 from 805 in Q2 ... coinciding with law enforcement action in early 2026 that dismantled four of the largest IoT DDoS botnets

claims.claim_text: CLDAP 反射攻擊下降 99.5%，DNS 放大成長 215%
claims.evidence: CLDAP floods collapsed by 99.5% quarter-over-quarter; DNS amplification surged 215%
claims.note: Source says 'CLDAP floods' (QoQ), lede says 'CLDAP 反射攻擊' with no period; DNS comparison period not stated in source. Minor imprecision, not blocking.

claims.claim_text: 以每次執行的成本中位數看，Hono+htmx 最低，約 2.67 美元，Angular 最高，約 4.97 美元；SvelteKit、Gracile+Lit 與 Angular 明顯比其他貴
claims.evidence: Hono+htmx $2.67 (2.23-3.19) ... Angular $4.97 (3.19-6.82) ... SvelteKit, Gracile+Lit, and Angular are more expensive to build than the other frameworks.
claims.note: Opus 5.5 high effort, PokeAPI Pokemon app, 12 approaches, a11y-tree conformance suite and caveats confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 請 Opus 5.5 以 high effort 在各個框架下各建五次（Angular 有兩次未能產出可量測的 app）
claims.location: item-01 lede (also top roundup lede: 每個框架各跑五次)
claims.evidence: I built the same app 5 times in the same framework. The exception was Angular, which failed to create a measurable app twice.
claims.note: Not uniformly five: Angular had only 3 measurable iterations. Correct to say 各建五次（Angular 有兩次未能產出可量測的 app）, and soften the hero lede 每個框架各跑五次 likewise.

claims.claim_text: Kyle Kingsbury 在 2026 年 10 月 31 日公布的 Jepsen 報告，測試了 ParticleDB 1.1.4 到 1.1.18.11.rc-22，回報 96 個問題，多數只要單一伺服器、單一用戶端、不注入任何故障就會出現
claims.evidence: We tested versions 1.1.4 through 1.1.18.11.rc-22. ... Most issues required just a single server, single client, and no faults.
claims.note: Page date 2026-10-31, author Kyle Kingsbury, 96 issues. Only first 100k of 137k chars read.

claims.claim_text: 除了十個以外都看似已修復，但預設的 occ 交易模式仍會遺失已提交的寫入，最強的 serializable 設定也出現 Lost Update。研究由 Orkes 出資，報告只涵蓋單節點
claims.evidence: all but ten of those issues appeared resolved; continued to lose committed writes during normal operation with the default `occ` transaction mode; This research was funded by Orkes, Inc.
claims.note: Page notes sources disagreed on the default (occ-v3 appeared default) but report text itself says default `occ`. Lost Update under serializable tied to process kills in Discussion; lede doesn't say otherwise.

claims.claim_text: opportunistic TLS 可被主動攻擊者降級，MTA-STS 與 DANE 能補洞但採用有限；Fastmail 認為 DANE 的機密性好處不值得 DNSSEC 帶來的可用性風險，並稱 Google 與 Yahoo 也做了類似選擇
claims.evidence: Other major providers such as Google and Yahoo have made similar choices, favouring MTA-STS over DANE.
claims.note: Fastmail 'doesn't currently consider the confidentiality benefits of DANE over MTA-STS to be worth the trade-off against increased availability risk' and will re-evaluate; Google/Yahoo is Fastmail's own claim and lede attributes it. At-rest keys held by provider, valid court orders can compel decryption: confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 別讓 foo 呼叫 bar，而是抽出私有 helper，讓兩者都呼叫它。……例外是「捷徑」API，……那裡的規則相反。作者坦承這篇缺一個具體範例
claims.evidence: I am drawing a blank here, so you gotta just blindly trust my say so!
claims.note: Private helper, optional-parameter growth, cheap local change, and shortcut-API exception ('the rule is the opposite') all confirmed.
